Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical (ATC) classification system

This Code system is referenced in the content logical definition of the following value sets:

  • This CodeSystem is not used here; it may be used elsewhere (e.g. specifications and/or implementations that use this content)

Filters

CodeDescriptionOpValue
concept Filter that includes concepts based on their logical definition, e.g. [concept] [is-a] [x] - include all concepts with an is-a relationship to concept x. is-a An ATC code

This code system http://www.whocc.no/atc defines the following codes in a Is-A hierarchy:
